The minimum is
\[
\boxed{\frac{1557-39\sqrt{39}}{95}},
\]
attained at permutations of
\[
\left(3-\frac{\sqrt{39}}3,\;3-\frac{\sqrt{39}}3,\;3+\frac{2\sqrt{39}}3\right).
\]
Indeed, writing \(r=xyz\), the expression becomes \((1876-36r)/(126-r)\), which decreases with \(r\). The product is maximized at the stated two-equal-variable triple.
